mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 330.5 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 330.5 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is high, the market anticipates policy tightening that increases risk aversion and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 330.5 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) generates wage pressures that lead to inflationary expectations, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1500) signals robust economic growth, which increases corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 and residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 700000, the economy is in a strong expansion phase, which increases equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 159000) indicates robust job creation, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 159000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
